en: <CLT=cltMIND>Just one?

<CLT=cltMIND>The other Monokubs aren't here to
bury Monokuma?

<CLT=cltMIND>...Well anyway, what Shuichi told me earlier is
really disturbing.
<CLT=cltMIND>One of us is cooperating with Monokuma...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's just so hard to believe.

<CLT=cltMIND>But Shuichi trusts me... That's why he told
me, right?
<CLT=cltMIND>Then...maybe I should believe it...

Wow, we're already out of material.
Like closing time at a sushi restaurant.

When a series lasts for several seasons,
eventually it'll run out of material.

My memory has been awful lately. I wonder if
it's cuz of how long the series has been going.

Wait...what season are we on again?
What material have we shown so far?

Geez, I don't remember. Maybe it's cuz
they've released so many at this point.

Oh well! Anyway, we need new material
for the Monokuma Theater!

Please send your manuscripts, along
with a 1,000 dollar application fee!

If your entry is selected, you will receive
a 100 dollar gift card!

What a generous prize! Don't miss this
opportunity! Send your applications today!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's already morning...
I didn't sleep well last night...

<CLT=cltMIND>Yesterday's conversation is still on my
mind...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what everyone else is doing.
Are they already gathered at the dining hall?
I guess I'll go for now...
Yes

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
